description.en:
The page number. Valid values: **1** to **100000**.

Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 每页显示的域名个数，默认值**20**，取值范围：**1**~**500**之间的任意整数。
description.en: The number of accelerated domain names per page. Valid values: **1** to **500**. Default value: **20**.

description.en: The query conditions for a fuzzy search of accelerated domain names. The value must be a JSON string. For example: {"DomainNameLike":"example.com"}

This API applies to the new version of WAF.
